gloss: ready asset; someone who can contribute immediately

definitions.gloss: ready asset; immediate asset; someone who can contribute right away
definitions.explanation: A person or resource that can be effective immediately without requiring additional training or preparation. Commonly used in hiring contexts and sports.

examples.japanese: {即戦力|そくせんりょく}になる{人材|じんざい}がほしい。
examples.english: We want someone who can hit the ground running.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{即戦力|そくせんりょく}として{期待|きたい}されている。
examples.english: He is expected to be an immediate contributor.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{採用|さいよう}では{即戦力|そくせんりょく}を{重視|じゅうし}している。
examples.english: In this round of hiring, we are prioritizing people who can contribute immediately.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in job postings and sports commentary. In the workplace, it describes experienced hires who need no training period. In sports, it refers to players (especially new recruits or transfers) who can perform at a high level from day one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即戦力|そくせんりょく}になる (to become an immediate asset)
- {即戦力|そくせんりょく}として{採用|さいよう}する (to hire as a ready contributor)
- {即戦力|そくせんりょく}を{求|もと}める (to seek ready talent)
